description: Windah reaches Chapter II of GTA VI and claims he is the first, comparing Lucia and Jason to Brando and Agnes (idea H4). Source = .cache/wizzclip/windah-gtavi-chapter2/source.mp4 (also Drive clip-src/windah-gtavi-chapter2.mp4): ONE part of stream-2132-2224.mp4 (Windah live 03qhcshfeMY 'GAMEPLAY #4', file t 0 = 20 Nov 2026 21:32:03 WIB) re-encoded to 1080p30: local 0-21.5 = t 2369.0-2390.5. Cuts: P2369 t 2369.45-2371.15 = local 0.45-2.15 -> output 0.00-1.70; P2369 t 2372.60-2385.55 = local 3.60-16.55 -> output 1.70-14.65; P2369 t 2386.72-2389.85 = local 17.72-20.85 -> output 14.65-17.78. Beats: 22:11:32-22:11:59 after the hospital cutscene Jason wakes up in the motel ('Where are we?'), the 'CHAPTER II' and 'Paradise Lost' title cards, Windah: 'Haaah... guys, gue orang pertama yang chapter 2, kak. Gila, Lucia, Jason ibarat Brando dan Agnes, men. Paradise Lost.' (Brando = Windah's real name), then 'kayak San Andreas pindah kota kah?'. Cut: the 'Anjay' before it (t 2385.55-2386.72, muted and removed, not in the subs), the idle bed shot (t 2371.15-2372.60), the hospital-gown cutscene before 39:24 (blood) and the gunfights at 30:00-38:26. Windah says 'gue orang pertama yang chapter 2' (his own claim, hook says 'WINDAH KLAIM'). Frames: Jason in bed, title cards, Lucia in the motel office, no guns, no swears. Main 17.78 s + 4.0 s outro. Short format (user, 19 Nov: clips 45-60 s lost viewers at ~10 s, so aim for 20-30 s, payoff first). Clean layout as windah-gtavi-sepatu; hook line 1 Paper 'WINDAH KLAIM ORANG PERTAMA', line 2 Volt 'SAMPAI CHAPTER 2 GTA VI', Audex 66. Word timings from faster-whisper medium on boosted audio. Cuts on input 0 stay in source order; an earlier-shown later moment has its own seeked input.
